reason: I've quit apps and services before, so Document A wins me over. It says plainly there's no contract and I can skip or cancel any time, it offers a 15-minute phone call with the dietitian, it lets me swap meals, and it's honest that the A1C numbers aren't a study. Document B still has placeholders like [Your Name] and leaves out the cancellation terms, the meal swaps and the call, so it feels unfinished and less trustworthy.
